newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Dos Bocas crude port shut - port.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Dos Bocas crude port shut - port.

text.p: Mexican crude port Dos Bocas in Tabasco state remained closed on Monday after storms shut the port Sunday at 2200 local/0300 GMT, port officials said.
The nation's two other major crude ports, Pajaritos in Veracruz state and Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, remained open throughout the bad weather, port officials told Reuters.
A port official at Dos Bocas said a 500,000 barrel capacity tanker was waiting to sail from the port.
The weak cold front was expected to move away from the Gulf of Mexico coast later in the day, according to the Transport and Communications Ministry.
Dos Bocas exported an average 505,900 barrels per day (bpd) in 1996, Pajaritos exported an average 416,200 bpd and Cayo Arcas shipped about 576,300 bpd, according to the latest Pemex figures.
